## Quality Assurance  
### Closure Audit Checklist  
**Before Marking "Closed":**
- [ ] Closure request properly documented
- [ ] Customer identity verified
- [ ] Final balance calculated correctly
- [ ] All standing orders/DDs cancelled
- [ ] Final payment initiated
- [ ] Closure confirmation sent to customer
- [ ] Account status updated in system
- [ ] Records flagged for 6-year archival  
**Monthly Audit:**
- 5+ closure files reviewed
- Check completeness and accuracy
- Verify timelines met
- Assess for compliance issues

raw_entities.name: Account Closure Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for closing a customer account, including verification of closure request, identity confirmation, final balance calculation, cancellation of standing orders and direct debits, final payment initiation, customer notification, system status update, and records archival. Includes monthly audit controls to verify completeness, accuracy, and compliance.
context: Before Marking "Closed": Closure request properly documented

raw_entities.name: Closure Request Documentation
raw_entities.description: Initial step to ensure the account closure request is properly documented before proceeding with closure activities.

raw_entities.name: Customer Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification of customer identity as a mandatory control before processing account closure.

raw_entities.name: Final Balance Calculation
raw_entities.description: Calculation and verification of the final account balance prior to closure.

raw_entities.name: Standing Orders and Direct Debits Cancellation
raw_entities.description: Cancellation of all active standing orders and direct debits on the account being closed.

raw_entities.name: Final Payment Initiation
raw_entities.description: Initiation of final payment to the customer for any remaining balance on the account.

raw_entities.name: Closure Confirmation Notification
raw_entities.description: Sending closure confirmation to the customer to acknowledge account closure completion.

raw_entities.name: Account Status System Update
raw_entities.description: Update of account status in the banking system to reflect closure.

raw_entities.name: Records Archival Flagging
raw_entities.description: Flagging of account records for 6-year archival retention in compliance with regulatory requirements.

raw_entities.name: Monthly Closure Audit Review
raw_entities.description: Monthly audit review of 5 or more closure files to verify completeness, accuracy, timeline compliance, and identify any compliance issues.

raw_entities.name: Closure Processing Staff
raw_entities.description: Operations staff responsible for executing closure steps including documentation verification, identity checks, balance calculation, and system updates.
context: Before Marking "Closed": Closure request properly documented

raw_entities.name: Audit Review Team
raw_entities.description: Team responsible for conducting monthly audit reviews of closure files to assess completeness, accuracy, timeline compliance, and compliance issues.

raw_entities.name: Account Closure Customer
raw_entities.description: Customer initiating account closure, whose identity must be verified and who receives closure confirmation notification.

raw_entities.name: Account Being Closed
raw_entities.description: The customer account subject to closure, including its final balance, standing orders, direct debits, and archival requirements.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order
raw_entities.description: Standing order payment instructions on the account that must be cancelled as part of the closure process.

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit
raw_entities.description: Direct debit mandates on the account that must be cancelled prior to account closure.

raw_entities.name: Closure Audit Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance control requiring records to be flagged for 6-year archival retention following account closure, ensuring regulatory record-keeping obligations are met.
